title: Two Three-Dimensional 2p–3d–4f Heterometallic Frameworks Featuring a Ln6Cu24Na12 Cluster as a Node

synthesis.procedure: The article reports reaction of L-alanine-N-monoacetic acid, copper(II) nitrate trihydrate, gadolinium(III) nitrate hexahydrate, and NaOH in deionized water under microwave irradiation. Reagent quantities and further preparation conditions are not given in the supplied main text.

reagents.name: Sodium hydroxide
reagents.amount: 1.0 mol L−1 solution; volume not specified

synthesis.temperature: 130 °C during microwave irradiation; room temperature during evaporation
synthesis.time: 10 min stirring; 30 min microwave irradiation; approximately two weeks evaporation
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filter the resulting cloudy solution and allow the aqueous filtrate to evaporate at room temperature. Blue block-shaped crystals form after two weeks.

properties.summary: Magnetic susceptibility measurements indicate ferrimagnetic behavior. The authors discuss competing ferro- and antiferromagnetic interactions within the cluster and possible antiferromagnetic interactions between clusters at low temperature.

measurements.name: Magnetization saturation field
measurements.conditions: Temperature not specified in the supplied main-text passage

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The Gd6Cu24Na12 node contains an inner Gd6Cu12 octahedral core, with Gd ions at its vertices and Cu ions at its edge midpoints, surrounded by six Na2Cu2 square units. Hydroxo and oxo bridges connect the metals, and a chloride ion occupies the center of the octahedral cage. ANMA ligands link these six-connected nodes into a three-dimensional framework.

synthesis.procedure: The article reports reaction of L-alanine-N-monoacetic acid, copper(II) nitrate trihydrate, dysprosium(III) nitrate hexahydrate, and NaOH in deionized water under microwave irradiation. Reagent quantities and further preparation conditions are not given in the supplied main text.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The article identifies 2 as isomorphic to the Gd analogue 1: a three-dimensional framework built from Dy6Cu24Na12 cluster nodes linked by ANMA ligands. Its corresponding Dy–O and metal–metal distances are reported separately from those of 1.
